sources.summary: Through a landscape project that includes a pair of contemplation shelters, Campano Frío is an initiative to reforest and restore an area of cloud forest. Located in a rural zone of the municipality of Villamaría, Caldas, along the Condor Route (Ruta del Cóndor), the site sits within the Río Claro sub-basin and the Río Chinchiná basin. The property was previously used for cattle grazing, which led to the clearing of the native forest to make way for invasive pasture grass.
